name: Old Lorek
description: Old Lorek stands by his skiff, avoiding the cave mouth as if it might look back.

dialogue.emote: keeps his eyes on the skiff, not the cave
dialogue.say: I'll wait here. Don't ask me to come in. When you're done, ask me to take you [back] and I'll row you to the docks.

back.emote: nods and reaches for the rope
back.say: Back to the docks? Good. I don't like this place.

return.emote: nods and reaches for the rope
return.say: Back to the docks? Good. I don't like this place.
